symbols.name: vector space
symbols.meaning: The vector space over F whose vectors a linear functional takes as input.
symbols.quote: Let $V$ be a vector space over the field $F$, whose vectors a functional takes as input.

symbols.name: linear functional
symbols.meaning: The map from V to F under study, which sends each vector to one scalar and respects addition and scalar multiplication.
symbols.quote: A map $f: V \to F$ is a linear functional when the following holds for all vectors $x, y$ in $V$ and all scalars $c, d$ in $F$:

symbols.name: coefficient
symbols.meaning: The value that the functional f takes on the vector with 1 in coordinate j and 0 elsewhere.
symbols.quote: where $a_j$ is the value $f$ takes on the vector with $1$ in coordinate $j$ and $0$ in every other coordinate.

relations.quote: A linear functional is built on the vector spaces and linear maps of [Linear algebra basics](linear-algebra-basics.md): it is a linear map from a vector space to its field of scalars.
